methodology: All active device outlines in individual illustrations and family share 6 SVG units (PNG pixels) per millimeter; caption space is independent of device size. Whole-image resizing preserves relative scale, but this is not an actual-size print guide.

Outlines represent the front-facing outer board or enclosure, excluding cables, detached antennas, batteries protruding behind the front plane and rear stands. Hardware details and screen placement are simplified, not precision CAD.

Screen captures are unchanged source pixels. Their aspect ratio is preserved with uniform scaling. CYD has a 240x320 physical panel with a centered 135x240 capture; the unused panel width stays black.

Screen sizes are manufacturer active-area dimensions when available. For the 1.14-inch and 5-inch panels, nominal active dimensions are calculated from the advertised diagonal and native pixel ratio, assuming square pixels; nominal diagonals are rounded specifications, not measured precision.
Silver uses the outer 92.5x70.1 mm housing envelope rather than the 92.5x69.1 mm PCB. Both linked hardware revisions share the same front envelope; their depth differs.
Waveshare1.69 drawing is rotated 90 degrees to portrait: its labeled 41.13x33.13 mm front becomes 33.13x41.13 mm; active area becomes 27.972x32.634 mm.
Manufacturer Nesso datasheet mechanical section takes precedence over conflicting 18x45 mm store/application copy.
